description: Synthetic argparse and stdin fixtures for sesslint.cli._common helper parity.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-common-load-baseline-set: _load_baseline_arg imports sesslint.baseline.load_baseline when --baseline is set; Rust returns LOAD_BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE (not Python baseline I/O).
GAP-common-write-baseline-set: _write_baseline_arg imports sesslint.baseline.write_baseline and uses CliContext.info when --write-baseline is set; Rust returns WRITE_BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE.
GAP-common-internal-error-json: _handle_internal_error json mode prints build_internal_error_envelope to stdout; Rust returns BUILD_INTERNAL_ERROR_ENVELOPE_UNAVAILABLE.
